@concat('"select COUNT_ID, GRGR_CK, GRGR_ID, CSCS_ID, CSPI_ID, PDPD_ID, COUNT, PULLED_DATE, DATE_SENT_TO_WARP, RUN_DATE,SALES_COUNT,LAPSE_COUNT, RPAD(ZIP,9,''0'') AS ZIPCODE, INVALID_ZIP 
FROM "', variables('gv_CountOracleTable'), '" 
WHERE DATE_SENT_TO_WARP IS NULL 
AND PULLED_DATE = TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('V_PULLED_DATE')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
AND RUN_DATE = TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('V_RUN_DATE')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM'') 

"')

@concat('"select COUNT_ID, GRGR_CK, GRGR_ID, CSCS_ID, CSPI_ID, PDPD_ID, COUNT, PULLED_DATE, DATE_SENT_TO_WARP, RUN_DATE,SALES_COUNT,LAPSE_COUNT, RPAD(ZIP,9,''0'') AS ZIPCODE, INVALID_ZIP 
FROM "', variables('gv_CountOracleTable'), '" 
WHERE PULLED_DATE = TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('V_PULLED_DATE')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')

"')

@concat('"select COUNT_ID, GRGR_CK, GRGR_ID, CSCS_ID, CSPI_ID, PDPD_ID, COUNT, PULLED_DATE, DATE_SENT_TO_WARP, RUN_DATE,SALES_COUNT,LAPSE_COUNT, RPAD(ZIP,9,''0'') AS ZIPCODE, INVALID_ZIP 
FROM "', variables('gv_CountOracleTable'), '" 
WHERE RUN_DATE = TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('V_RUN_DATE')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM'') 

"')

  FROM dbo.STAGE_MEMBER_DETAIL a
  WHERE a.BATCH_ID = @0
